modVersion.name: Version
modVersion.hint: Currently installed module version (can't be changed here).

debug.name: Debug mode
debug.hint: Client-side setting enabling extended debug logging.

forceUniqueTargetToken.name: Force target token selection
forceUniqueTargetToken.hint: Prevent "crunching" when no unique group member has been selected. Most relevant for scenes that use levels and elevation, because group members get teleported to the same position and elevation! as the target.

maxNoOfParties.name: Maximum number of parties
maxNoOfParties.hint: How many separately defined parties should be maintained at once?

memberTokenNames#.name: Party # - Members (deprecated)
memberTokenNames#.hint: Not used anymore since v14. Only visible for easier takeover of old settings.

partyTokenName#.name: Party # - Party name (deprecated)
partyTokenName#.hint: Not used anymore since v14. Only visible for easier takeover of old settings.

hideChatInfo.name: Hide module info in chat window
hideChatInfo.hint: Hides the info text about this module in the chat window on game start, so that it doesn't show up over and over again (deactivate this option to see it again).

animationFileCRUNCHED.name: "Crunch" animation (optional)
animationFileCRUNCHED.hint: Animation to play when crunching single tokens into party token. Requires installation of J2BA (see Readme).

playAudioCRUNCHED.name: Play audio on "Crunch"?
playAudioCRUNCHED.hint: Plays the audio file specified below, if activated.

audioFileCRUNCHED.name: Audio file on "Crunch"
audioFileCRUNCHED.hint: Audio file (relative path) to be played on "Crunch"?

animationFileEXPLODED.name: "Explode" animation (optional)
animationFileEXPLODED.hint: Animation to play when exploding party token into single member tokens. Requires installation of J2BA (see Readme).

playAudioEXPLODED.name: Play audio on "Explode"?
playAudioEXPLODED.hint: Plays the audio file specified below, if activated.

audioFileEXPLODED.name: Audio file on "Explode"

chatInfoContent.title: Crunch My Party!
chatInfoContent.text1:
"Once there were three little goblins... eager to form a PARTY!
So here's their story..."
chatInfoContent.text2: Easily collapse arbitrary groups of scene tokens (representing parties) into an easy-to-use single "party token", and vice versa. Manage up to 5 separate parties with up to 25 members each!
chatInfoContent.text3: Please refer to the various module preferences under game settings. Find even more details on GitHub
chatInfoContent.footer: This chat card will only be shown once. Activate once more in the module settings if needed.

errMsg.invalidTokenCount: Required: Exactly ONE group and MORE THAN ONE members
errMsg.duplicateTokens: Selection contains tokens of the same name (maybe hidden?). Name-siblings prohibit a consistent party configuration.
errMsg.invalidNumberOfMemberTokens: Invalid number of tokens selected! A party must consist of 2 to {maxMembers} members.

errMsg.partyTokenMissingInConfig: The party configuration is missing data for the party token named '#tokenName'. Please add it to the scene, or recreate the party using the "Group" macro.
errMsg.noTokensVisible: Either the party token OR at least one of the party members must be visible (activated) in the scene to perform this action.
errMsg.membersAndPartyTokenVisible: Party token and members cannot be visible at the same time to perform this action.
errMsg.pleaseWaitStillBusy: Please wait for current action to complete. If this issue persists, please reload the scene.
errMsg.partyConfigNotDefined: Party #{partyNo} doesn't seem to be configured. Please check your Party definitions list.
